meta.coverage: General index and the three sectors, financial-year averages and their growth, 1981-82 to 1997-98
meta.note: Base 1980-81=100, the oldest IIP ruler: a separate bundle, never spliced with 1993-94=100 or later (the two overlap from April 1994 to March 1998). MoSPI's eSankhyiki API does not serve this base; the RBI's DBIE copy of the CSO index is the source here. Growth on a year earlier is computed from the published index levels. Financial-year averages as the RBI publishes them (report 219); growth is computed from those averages.
